gates.evidence: The proposal targets the Settings screen (s19), which is an SFW surface.
The reward is a time-boxed entitlement (Luzia+), not cash, crypto, or incentivized clicks.
The proposal uses a gain-framing offer ('Try Upgrade to Luzia+ for a game') without hostage or loss tactics.
The user explicitly opts in via a 'Play to try' button on the chip.
The proposal explicitly states: 'Play a 15-second game to unlock 30 minutes of Upgrade to Luzia+ today.'
The proposal includes an explicit 'No thanks' button.
The offer is placed on the Settings screen (s19), not inside a chat or generation stream.
The proposal explicitly specifies: 'All users, including subscribers, on every app open.' This violates the policy against showing ads to subscribers [ANTI-16].

scores.evidence: The trigger is linked directly to the 'Upgrade to Luzia+' upsell in Settings (m23), which is where users demonstrate interest in premium features.
The integration is subtle, appearing as a chip in the Settings menu without degrading the AI chat or generation experience.
The proposal explicitly targets subscribers (eligibility: 'All users, including subscribers'), which is a high risk for perceived bait-and-switch and cannibalization of subscription value [ANTI-16].
The cost to serve is effectively zero (entitlement access), which fits well within the computed US revenue per view.
Settings (s19) is a frequent tab (m12, m19), but not the core loop of chat or image creation.
The proposal uses existing Simula units (SIM-RWD) and maps cleanly to the Settings screen upsell.
Uses identified screens (s19) and resources (r1) correctly.
The proposal suggests showing the offer on 'every app open' for eligible users, which is overly aggressive and likely to cause fatigue, despite the daily caps.
Defines primary metrics (sample opt-ins) and includes a 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Exclude existing Luzia+ subscribers from ad eligibility; this is a hard policy requirement [ANTI-16].
Change eligibility from 'every app open' to a more reasonable trigger, such as on the first Settings visit per session or after a paywall decline to avoid fatigue.
Ensure the offer is only shown to non-subscribers to prevent devaluing the paid membership.
parsed.topConcern: The proposal targets existing subscribers with ads, which risks severe user backlash and violates the policy against showing rewarded ads to paying users who already possess the entitlement.
